Ange det kvarvarande nominella avdrag so: Enter the remaining nominal deduction already transferred to this property’s cost basis. This is not a Swedish deferral and has no Swedish voluntary recapture.
Ange faktiska eller planerade förfalloda: Enter actual or planned due dates when annual settlement requires payment or refund. No date is required for a zero balance. One date per line (YYYY-MM-DD), in ascending order without duplicates.
Annan bostad som omfattas av reglerna: Other residence covered by the rules
Begär uppskov för en kvalificerad ersätt: Request deferral for a qualifying replacement home
Bekräfta skatterättslig hemvist hela åre: Confirm tax residence for the full year.
Belopp avser postens ägare; gemensamma b: Amounts apply to the owner of the item; joint amounts are split equally between adults. The ownership share is used for statutory amount limits.
Belopp efter prövning av ersättningsbost: Amounts after review of replacement home
Betalningsbelopp enligt slutskattebesked: Payment amounts per final tax notice
Betalningsdatum efter prövning av ersätt: Payment dates after review of replacement home
Betalningsdatum enligt slutskattebesked: Payment dates per final tax notice
Bostaden har använts som min egen bostad: The property was used as my own residence
Det faktiska historiska datumet behövs f: The actual historical date is required for the country’s ownership and residence duration rules.
Endast full skatterättslig hemvist hela: Only full-year tax residence is supported.
Island: ägartid, egen användning och i t: Iceland: ownership duration, personal use and, where applicable, volume limits are assessed. A deferral reduces the replacement home’s cost basis under national rules.
Isländska årsregler 2026. Ange faktisk k: Icelandic annual rules for 2026. Enter actual municipal tax and actual deductible pension contributions. Each pension class may be at most 4% of annual salary. No pension contributions are assumed automatically.
Lämna tomt för samma datum som Försäljni: Leave blank to use the same date as Sale → Sell at. The settlement and contract dates may differ.
Sammanlagd bostadsvolym som omfattas av: Total residential volume covered by ownership
Skattskyldig hela året: Tax resident for the full year
Tidigare överfört avdrag i bostadens ans: Previous transferred deduction in the property cost basis
Volymgränsen bedöms för sambeskattade ma: Volume limit assessed for jointly taxed spouses
Välj årsbedömning för den årliga skattea: Choose an annual assessment for the annual tax reconciliation.
Årets ytterligare avdragsgilla pensionsi: Additional deductible pension contributions this year
label: Iceland
Lämna förvalet för att använda landuppgi: Keep the default to use the country from the linked property. Select an explicit country if that detail needs clarification.
Ange ett nominellt belopp i landets valu: Enter one nominal amount in the country’s currency per line, in the same order as the dates. Negative amounts indicate refunds. If you enter multiple dates, enter an amount for each date.
